LUDO

Offline · Pass & Play

How to play
  • Roll a 6 to bring a token out of its yard.
  • A 6, a capture, or sending a token home gives you another roll.
  • Three 6s in a row and you lose your turn.
  • Land on an opponent on an unsafe square to send it back home.
  • Coloured squares and ★ squares are safe.
  • You need the exact number to finish a token.
  • First player to get all 4 tokens home wins.
